propositions: A PreToolUse hook must emit a 2–3 line JSON-formatted reminder when the Bash tool executes grep-family commands (grep, rg, egrep, fgrep) to re-surface Serena as the preferred symbol lookup tool.
The hook trigger must match grep-family strings in the command without pattern classification, path heuristics, or command parsing to avoid false negatives and remain maintainable.

The reminder message must name both the preferred path (find_referencing_symbols) and legitimate grep exceptions (string-literal symbols and line numbers) so an agent continuing with grep is still informed.
The hook must be non-blocking and informative only: it emits JSON with additionalContext, never emits permissionDecision, and never exits non-zero, ensuring the grep command executes unchanged.
The hook script must be tracked in scripts/hooks/serena_grep_reminder.py for testability and pin the trigger and message to an automated test.
The hook configuration must merge into .claude/settings.json alongside story C's env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH setting without overwriting it.
